protocol: Exploratory fixed baselines after test was opened. TF-IDF with smoothed IDF, sublinear TF, L2 cosine; char 3-5 grams and whitespace-token 1-3 grams. IDF fits the candidate bank without labels. Stable index-order ties, self/same-style-equivalent exclusion identical to original. No parameter sweep. Bootstrap resamples behaviors, not training seeds.

caveats: 1 explicitly audited program variant(s) excluded after grouping/split assignment
Fewer than four distinct visible examples after hidden-input exclusion.
Held out because template or witness skeleton connects to official v4 eval.
Independent verification report is keyed by behavior id, without a program digest; programs were not re-executed.
Preliminary peer-scale snapshot; verified on its own examples, not a novelty certificate.
